scripts.render: remotion render DocBroTeaser out/raw.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/raw.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -ar 48000 -c:a aac -b:a 192k out/docbro-teaser.mp4
scripts.render:reel: remotion render DocBroReel out/raw-reel.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/raw-reel.mp4 -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1.5:LRA=11 -ar 48000 -c:a aac -b:a 192k out/docbro-reel.mp4
